description: Asks, on a writable copy, which column and table clauses CREATE TABLE accepts through Database.Execute (dbFailOnError), each statement its own table Cc<i> followed by DBEngine.Errors: NOT NULL and NULL, DEFAULT, column-level and table-level PRIMARY KEY (single, composite, with direction, repeated and mixed), UNIQUE in column and table form, an INDEX clause, CHECK in column and table form, a trailing comma, no columns, no column list, a repeated column name in two cases, a missing type, a missing comma, COLLATE, COMMENT, AUTO_INCREMENT, IDENTITY, UNSIGNED, REFERENCES in column and table form with and without a column list, and a computed-column spelling. Then for each created table the fields (Name, Type, Attributes, Required, AllowZeroLength) and indexes (Name, Primary, Unique, IgnoreNulls, Required) are read. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
